name: AquaOx
headline: AquaOx
description: A plant complex of four powerful antioxidants — pomegranate, acai berry, cocoa bean and rosemary extracts. It helps protect cells from damage, keeps the body's systems working in balance and supports healthy, active longevity.
howToUse: Adults – 1 capsule twice a day with food, in the morning and midday.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
manufacturing.ingredients: Pomegranate fruit extract, acai fruit extract, cocoa bean extract, rosemary leaf extract, excipients.
